projects.title: Rainy-Day Scavenger Hunt
projects.summary: Create a printable or screen-friendly clue trail for a rainy day at home.
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; no answers are uploaded.
projects.supervision: Designed for a grown-up to prepare and supervise.

projects.title: Silly Story Spinner
projects.summary: Mix a character, a place and a surprise to create a family story prompt, then take turns adding the next line.
projects.social_subtitle: Build a Silly Story Spinner with AI
projects.social_caption: AI Inquisitive Parents: try building a Silly Story Spinner with AI. Choose a character, a place and a surprise, then make up the story together. I made a working browser version—so can you. Try it at https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/parents/projects/day-002/ #AIInquisitiveParents #FamilyFun #BuildWithAI
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; choices are not uploaded or saved.
projects.supervision: Designed for families to create and tell stories together.

projects.title: Family Adventure Dice
projects.summary: Roll a place, a mission and a playful twist to turn an ordinary half-hour into a tiny family adventure.
projects.social_subtitle: Build Family Adventure Dice with AI
projects.social_caption: AI Inquisitive Parents: try building Family Adventure Dice with AI. Roll a place, a mission and a funny twist, then enjoy a small activity together. I made a private browser version—so can you. Try it at https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/parents/projects/day-003/ #AIInquisitiveParents #FamilyFun #BuildWithAI
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; choices are not uploaded or saved.
projects.supervision: Designed for families to adapt and enjoy together; grown-ups choose what suits their home and children.

projects.title: Make-It-Yours Planner
projects.summary: Choose, rename and print the sections you actually need in a private planner built around real family life.
projects.social_hook: CAN'T FIND THE APP YOU NEED?
projects.social_subtitle: Make the useful version yourself with AI
projects.social_caption: AI Inquisitive Parents: can't find the app that would genuinely make life easier? It may be because you haven't made it yet. Describe what you need, what you do not want and your level of AI knowledge—then build the first useful version. Try my private Make-It-Yours Planner at https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/parents/projects/day-004/ #AIInquisitiveParents #BuildWithAI #ParentTools #FamilyOrganisation #PracticalAI
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; planner choices and writing stay on the device.
projects.supervision: Designed for adults to tailor around their own household; it does not prescribe diets, targets or routines for children.

projects.title: Family Meal Picker
projects.summary: Add the meals your family actually eats, collect everyone's votes and choose fairly from the highest-rated available options.
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; names, meals and votes stay in local browser storage.
projects.supervision: A grown-up must check allergies, dietary needs, ingredients and suitability.

projects.title: My Words Spelling Game
projects.summary: Turn the words a child is learning now into a private listen-and-type spelling game with a choice of English browser voices.
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; the word list, selected voice and score stay in local browser storage.
projects.supervision: A grown-up chooses suitable words and checks that the selected browser voice pronounces them clearly.

projects.title: Ready-to-Go Bag Checker
projects.summary: Create reusable, personalised packing lists for school, nursery, swimming or days out, then tick, reset and reuse them.
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; bag names, items and packing status stay in local browser storage.
projects.supervision: A grown-up creates and checks each list, including any medication or safety-critical items.

projects.title: Family Job Board
projects.summary: Create paid family jobs, let children mark them finished and keep reward approval and pocket-money totals under grown-up control.
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; names, jobs, approvals and balances stay in local browser storage.
projects.supervision: A grown-up agrees rewards, checks completed jobs, approves earnings and handles any real payment.

projects.title: Make-It-Your-Own Quiz
projects.summary: Build a private multiple-choice quiz around a child's current interests or learning, then shuffle, play, score and replay it.
projects.privacy: Runs entirely in the browser; custom questions and answers stay in local browser storage.
projects.supervision: A grown-up creates or checks every question and answer for accuracy and suitability.
